editorial:
Imagine going on a first date that starts out normal but quickly turns into a total nightmare. You follow a woman who finds herself running for her life through the streets of Los Angeles after her date becomes violent for no clear reason. The movie feels like a chase that never stops, keeping you on edge as you wonder why this man is hunting her and if she can actually get away. It has a gritty, real-world feel that makes the danger feel close to home, turning a simple night out into a fight for survival.

What really works here is the lead actress, who does a great job showing pure panic and strength. The pacing is quick, though some parts might feel a bit repetitive if you aren't into long chase scenes. If you love thrillers that keep you guessing, you should definitely check this out. It is a solid pick for a weekend movie night.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the main character is actually the villain. She has a mental illness and has been imagining the chase to hide her own crimes. She wasn't being hunted by a stranger; she was actually the one attacking people. In the end, you realize everything you saw was a trick of her mind. She is finally caught, and the truth about her violent past comes out to the police.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological twists and chase movies.
